ja: 彼女、今朝からずっと機嫌が悪いよ。
en: She's been grumpy since this morning.
alternatives: She's been moody since this morning.
She's been cranky since this morning.
point: 「今朝からずっと」は is ではなく has been で表す

ja: 私、今すごく緊張してる。
en: I'm feeling really nervous right now.
alternatives: I'm really nervous right now.
I'm so nervous right now.
point: 「今〜な気分」は feel を進行形にして I'm feeling とできる

ja: 雨なら、家にいたほうがよくない？
en: If it rains, shouldn't we stay home?
alternatives: Shouldn't we stay home if it rains?
Wouldn't staying home be better if it rains?
point: 未来でも if 節は現在形 it rains

ja: 昨日の映画、なぜ気に入らなかったの？
en: Why didn't you like yesterday's movie?
alternatives: Why didn't you enjoy yesterday's movie?
How come you didn't like yesterday's movie?
point: 過去の否定疑問は Why didn't you のあと動詞は原形

ja: 母が一番喜んだのは、孫たちからの手紙でした。
en: It was the grandkids' letters that pleased my mother most.
alternatives: What pleased my mother most was the grandkids' letters.
The grandkids' letters were what pleased my mother most.
point: 強調したい部分を It was と that で挟む

ja: 兄は、私が誕生日を覚えていたことに大喜びした。
en: My brother was thrilled I'd remembered his birthday.
alternatives: My brother was so happy I had remembered his birthday.
My brother was delighted that I'd remembered his birthday.
point: 喜んだ時点より前のことなので覚えていたは had + 過去分詞

ja: 新しい仕事にはもう慣れたよ。
en: I've gotten used to my new job.
alternatives: I'm used to my new job now.
I've settled into my new job.
point: 「慣れた」は have gotten used to で現在完了

ja: 正直な意見、聞いてもいいですか？
en: Could I ask your honest opinion?
alternatives: May I ask for your honest opinion?
Could I get your honest opinion?
point: 丁寧な許可は Could I / May I で始める

ja: 宝くじが当たったら、君は仕事辞める？
en: Would you quit if you won the lottery?
alternatives: If you won the lottery, would you quit?
If you hit the jackpot, would you quit?
point: ありえない仮定は if 節を過去形、主節を would にする

ja: 上司に本当のこと言ったほうがいいよ。
en: You should tell your boss the truth.
alternatives: You should be honest with your boss.
I'd tell your boss the truth.
point: 「〜したほうがいい」は should + 動詞の原形

ja: 最近よく眠れてなくて、ちょっと参ってる。
en: I haven't been sleeping well. It's wearing me down.
alternatives: I haven't slept well lately. It's wearing me out.
I haven't slept well lately. It's getting to me.
point: 「参ってる」は wear down / wear out で表せる

ja: 一番がっかりなのは、誰も手伝わなかったこと。
en: What disappointed me most was that nobody helped.
alternatives: Honestly, the worst part was that no one helped.
The most disappointing thing was that nobody helped.
point: 「〜なのは」は what 節、「〜ということ」は that 節で表す

ja: こんなに温かく迎えられるとは、夢にも思わなかった。
en: Never did I imagine such a warm welcome.
alternatives: I never imagined I'd be welcomed so warmly.
I never dreamed of such a warm welcome.
point: Never を文頭に出すと did I imagine の語順になる

ja: あの頃、もっと正直になればよかった。
en: I wish I'd been more honest back then.
alternatives: If only I'd been more honest back then.
I wish I'd been more upfront back then.
point: 過去への後悔は wish の後を過去完了にする

ja: 彼女にあんなこと言うべきじゃなかった。
en: I shouldn't have said that to her.
alternatives: I never should have said that to her.
I shouldn't have told her that.
point: 過去への後悔は shouldn't have + 過去分詞

ja: この服、派手すぎると思う？
en: Do you think it's too bright?
alternatives: Do you think it's too flashy?
Do you think it's too loud?
point: Do you think の後ろは it's と普通の語順

ja: ここ、好き！また来ようよ。
alternatives: I love it! Let's come again.
Love this place! Let's come again.
point: 「〜しようよ」は Let's + 動詞の原形

ja: 兄に映画を最後まで見させられて、ムッとした。
en: My brother made me finish the movie. Annoying!
alternatives: My brother made me watch the whole movie. Annoying!
My brother made me finish the film. Ugh!
point: 「無理やり〜させる」は make 人 + 動詞の原形
